title: Sell Mineral Rights in Elkland, PA
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Elkland, PA | Tioga County
metaDescription: Elkland sits in Tioga County's dry-gas Marcellus core near the New York border. We buy PA mineral and royalty interests directly from owners, cash offer.
heroLead: Elkland sits along the Tioga River near the New York border, deep in dry-gas country that's seen some of the most productive Marcellus drilling anywhere in the state.
intro: Tioga County has been ground zero for dry-gas Marcellus development in northeastern Pennsylvania, and Elkland-area farmland sits within a footprint that operators like Shell and, historically, other majors have targeted heavily for over a decade. This isn't a wet-gas play like southwestern Pennsylvania, dry gas means the produced stream is almost entirely methane rather than a mix of gas and liquids, which changes how these wells are valued and priced against benchmark gas rather than a liquids-heavy basket.
If your family owns land or an inherited mineral interest near Elkland, we're glad to review it and make a direct cash offer based on the actual production history nearby.

sections.heading: Dry-Gas Core Near the New York Border
paragraphs: Elkland sits in one of the most consistently productive dry-gas corners of the entire Marcellus play, a stretch of Tioga County that drew major operator investment early and has stayed active since. Because dry gas is priced against benchmark natural gas rather than a liquids-heavy basket, value here tends to move more directly with broader gas market prices than in the wet-gas counties to the southwest.
That established production history means we can often look at specific nearby well performance when evaluating a Elkland-area interest, rather than relying on general regional assumptions.

sections.heading: Farmland Assembled Into Large Units
paragraphs: Tioga County's rural character has meant large, contiguous farmland tracts have been common building blocks for drilling units here, often larger than what's typical in more subdivided parts of southwestern Pennsylvania. If your family's land is part of one of these larger units, your interest may reflect a smaller percentage of a bigger, more productive whole, which we factor into how we evaluate the interest.

sections.heading: Older Leases in a Long-Running Play
paragraphs: Because development here started relatively early, some Elkland-area leases date back to the initial dry-gas leasing wave and can carry terms different from what's become standard more recently, particularly around post-production deductions. We review your specific lease alongside your current statement before discussing what a sale might make sense against.

faqs.question: Is Elkland in an active part of the Marcellus dry-gas play?
faqs.answer: Yes, this part of Tioga County has been one of the most productive dry-gas corners of the entire play for years.

faqs.question: How is dry-gas value different from the wet-gas areas in southwestern PA?
faqs.answer: Dry gas is priced against benchmark natural gas prices, rather than a liquids-heavy basket, so value here tends to track broader gas market prices more directly.

faqs.question: My family's interest is a small share of a larger drilling unit. Does that still have value?
faqs.answer: Yes. We evaluate fractional interests in larger units regularly and can make a direct offer on your specific share.
